profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary:
Innovative, curious, inclusive.  I love the focus, challenge, and accomplishment of contributing to a group work effort. I am always learning.

Web Developer with experience in a wide variety of business applications and open source technologies.

Primary experience is with PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, MySQL, and Wordpress multisite development.

Skills:

* PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery
* Data management
* WordPress:  Plugins, Themes, Gutenberg, Full Site Editor
* Client support
* Git, Responsive Design, Figma, Jira, MS Office
* React, UX/UI, AWS
* Excellent communication, analytical and problem solving skills

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: * Implement website design as specified by Designer
positions.insights: Skills: OS X · Problem Solving · PHP · Site Build · Wordpress Development · E-Commerce

positions.title: AI Annotator
positions.description:
* Annotate AI Models using various methodologies: A/B Model evaluation; Prompt and validate response; Layer prompts with increasing complexity; Dataset analysis
* Content included: Programming languages (Python, SQL, JavaScript, JSON); Structured data (complex spreadsheets, data dictionary); Textual data (written content, customer reviews)
* Validate annotation decisions of other Annotaters to ensure quality and accuracy
* Manage projects to prioritize high priority tasks
positions.insights: Skills: Written Communication · Python (Programming Language) · Problem Solving · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Data Analysis

positions.title: Web Developer, Project Manager
positions.description:
* Created responsive design "BookStop" promotion for member books - generated $25,000 annually
* Utilize API for purchases, bulk email, real-time graphing, Google analytics
* Enhance and maintain complex WordPress multisite with Membership, Events, 50+ custom plugins
* Implement UI designs from Figma designs
* Maintain all technical aspects of the website, from cloud server to plugin development - the full LAMP stack
* Extensive use of SQL for ad hoc reporting, extracts, and analytics
* Utilize Git for version control
* Manage technical contractors for web development, UI design, and graphic design
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · OS X · Help Desk Support · AJAX · Communication · Written Communication · Technical Support · Problem Solving · HTML · CSS · System Administration · jQuery · Project Management · Technical Advisory · Ticketing Systems · Wordpress Development · PHP Applications · PhpMyAdmin
